name: Redesign of checkout
introduction: To start with my projects, the next one was my first professional opportunity to take design and accessibility decisions on a system
dialogues: On one of the systems I was working on, there was a checkout functionality for products
One client's system reported that their employees were slow checking out when using the mouse and keyboard
Redesigned the checkout interface to improve usability and integrate navigation with only keyboard
Reorganized the process and interaction flow, dividing it into 3 columns and each one with the same vertical reading pattern
Made payment methods independent, improving error and change handling without restarting checkout process
Learned to prioritize user experience and to consider different ways of interaction

images.caption: Decoupled recorded payment methods into buttons, easier to delete or modify
